observations: Photo 0 and 1 show a bare 4-cylinder car engine assembly, removed from a vehicle, sitting on a shop floor.
Visible parts: valve cover with 4 ignition coils, oil filler cap, alternator, serpentine belt pulleys, various hoses and brackets.
A watermark reads 'EMMY GOLD AUTO SPARE' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' - this is the seller's shop branding, not an engine identifier.
No manufacturer logo (Hyundai or Kia emblem) is visible on the block, head, or covers in either photo.
No engine code, casting number, or ID plate is legible in either photo.
No spark plugs, no fuel rail detail, no wiring harness connectors are shown in a way that indicates completeness.
No power-on, compression test, or video evidence of the engine running is shown.

claims.evidence: No Hyundai or Kia logo, casting mark, or engine code is legible in photo 0 or photo 1; claim rests on seller's text alone.
Photo 0 shows four ignition coils mounted in a row on the valve cover, consistent with an inline-4 layout.

risks.risk: Exact engine code/displacement unconfirmed, which drives most of the price difference between Hyundai/Kia 4-cylinder variants.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the stamped engine code/ID plate (usually on the block near the bellhousing or on a sticker on the valve cover).
risks.if_unproven: priced as unidentified generic 4-cylinder Hyundai/Kia engine, lowest common variant

risks.risk: Running condition unknown - no compression, no start-up, no smoke/noise check possible from photos.
risks.proof: Video of the engine cranking/running with audio, plus a compression test reading.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not confirmed running (worst case: non-running/parts engine)

risks.risk: Mileage and internal wear (timing chain/belt, bearings, sludge) cannot be seen from exterior shots.
risks.proof: Odometer photo from the donor vehicle or workshop mileage/teardown report.

risks.risk: Completeness not verified - sensors, wiring harness, turbo (if any), intake manifold condition not fully shown.
risks.proof: Full 360° photo set including intake side, harness connectors, and underside of the engine.
risks.if_unproven: priced as possibly missing ancillary parts

risks.risk: Possible flood, fire, or accident damage not visible in these close crops.
risks.proof: Wide shot of the whole engine bay/engine on a stand plus photos of underside and bellhousing for damage.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified condition, worst case assumed

proof_requests: Clear photo of the engine code/ID plate or stamped number on the block
Video of the engine cranking or running with sound
Wide shot showing the full engine from multiple angles including underside and bellhousing
Photo of the donor vehicle's VIN plate or registration showing the matching engine spec
response.reason: The photos show a plausible 4-cylinder engine but no legible brand, model, or engine code to confirm the seller's Hyundai/Kia claim or which variant it is, and pricing used engines depends heavily on that exact identification.
